Dear all,
In the first step in Module: Query Database, I queried my target species and then records appeared. But I could not download the csv file (error "dlDbOccs failed") to merge my records. How can i solve the problem? Best, K.

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: problem download occurence data from GBIF..
parts:
Hi Kerim,

This is a bug in the CRAN version of Wallace. Hopefully, this issue was reported and fixed in the development version of Wallace in GitHub (link with the issue). Please, install Wallace from Github using the following code:

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("wallaceEcoMod/wallace")
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

Also, the problem will be fixed in the next release on CRAN.

Let me know if this fixes your problem.

Best,
Gonzalo
